title: Monotonicity of the exponential code bound
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and natural numbers $s\le s'$, the exponential bound $kb(N,n,s)$ is at most $kb(N,n,s')$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
